assumptions.ruleSet: Standard Expansion treasure-class and quality rolls, with ReMoDDeD Forsaken Pact recipe exclusions

assumptions.population: Density-based area population with sampled elite packs, minions, current DS1 layout alternatives and verified campaign/seal/wave encounters. Procedural geometry, placement success and elite allocation remain approximations; skill summons and unbound scripts are excluded.
